name: picklist-print-next25

actions.command: doppler run -p shared-services -c prd -- bash -c 'cd skills/active/picklist-ops && ./run.sh --manual-next25'

_comment: Manual 'Print next 25' button. POST to /webhook/picklist/next25 with a valid x-api-key header. No body required.

name: picklist-print-selected

actions.command: ORDER_IDS=$(printf '%s' '{{body}}' | jq -r '.order_ids // empty' | tr -cd '0-9,') && [ -n "$ORDER_IDS" ] && doppler run -p shared-services -c prd -- bash -c "cd skills/active/picklist-ops && ./run.sh --manual-selected '$ORDER_IDS'" || echo 'picklist-selected: no order_ids in request body'

_comment: Manual 'Print selected orders' button. POST to /webhook/picklist/selected with body: {"order_ids": "1234567,1234568"}. x-api-key header required.

name: picklist-print-label

actions.command: ORDER_ID=$(printf '%s' '{{body}}' | jq -r '.order_id // empty' | tr -cd '0-9') && [ -n "$ORDER_ID" ] && doppler run -p shared-services -c prd -- bash -c "cd skills/active/picklist-ops && ./print-label.sh '$ORDER_ID'" || echo 'picklist-print-label: no order_id in request body'

_comment: Programmatic label-print trigger. POST to /webhook/picklist/print-label with body: {"order_id": "1234567"}. Used when the pack station scanner app POSTs the QR scan result rather than opening a browser.
